text.p: Everen Securities said on Tuesday it cut its rating on the shares of 360 Communications Co to market perform intermediate-term from an outperform, but kept its long-term outperform rating on the stock.

-- "We believe the company is taking a hit to EBITDA and earnings due to its...roaming business," analyst Thomas Kurey said. This business allowed 360 customers to roam on the networks of other service providers.
-- Kurey said 360 Communications had made money on this in the past but now was subsidizing the operation.
-- Kurey said he reduced his 1997 earnings estimate to $0.63 per share from $0.68 per share and his 1998 earnings estimate to $1.04 per share from $1.16 per share.
